## Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored E2EE API

Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored E2EE is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-gemma-4-26b-a4b-uncensored-p`. It is end-to-end encrypted.

Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). An uncensored variant of Google's Gemma 4 MoE model with 25.2B total / 3.8B active parameters, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

### How to use the Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-gemma-4-26b-a4b-uncensored-p"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-gemma-4-26b-a4b-uncensored-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
